# Project Blueprints & Scaffolding Engine

Detailed specification of the file layout generated by `krew new` and `krew init`, shape detection rules, and custom starter template integration.

---

## 1. Scaffolding Architecture

Scaffolding has two distinct layers:
1. **Runtime Scaffolds ([`krew/internal/scaffold`](../../../krew/internal/scaffold))**: The canonical Go generator logic that `krew new` and `krew init` execute at runtime.
2. **Reference Blueprints (`templates/init/`, `templates/new/`)**: In-tree reference blueprints showcasing canonical directory layouts for documentation and testing.

---

## 2. Fresh Project Scaffold (`krew new`)

`krew new <name> [flags]` runs two layers in one command:
1. Writes the minimal bootstrap files (`go.mod`, `krewire.yaml`, starter `main.go`, `.gitignore`, `git init`).
2. Equips the chosen workload variant (fullstack `app` by default) into the directory.

```bash
krew new my-project              # Defaults to fullstack app
krew new my-site --site          # Scaffolds static website
krew new my-tool --cli           # Scaffolds command-line tool
krew new my-docs --book          # Scaffolds documentation book
```

### The Pre-Init Bootstrap State
The minimal bootstrap files alone represent a `pre-init` state, **not** an operational workload kind:
- Shape detection reports `KindNone` with the marker `pre-init`.
- Workload commands (`krew build`, `krew dev`, `krew run`) refuse to run and point the developer to `krew init`.
- `krew new` immediately transitions out of this state by equipping the chosen variant.

---

## 3. In-Place Scaffolds (`krew init`)

`krew init` equips an existing directory without clobbering foreign project files (`package.json`, `composer.json`):

### Summary of the Eight Workload Variants

| Variant Flag | Primary Files & Structure | Bootstrap `main.go` | Use Case |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *(bare)* | `krewire.yaml`, `.gitignore`, `git init` | Untouched | Minimal repository setup |
| **`--app`** | `main.go`, `internal/app`, `internal/http`, `web/`, `assets/` | Replaced with fullstack SSR router | Dynamic fullstack web applications |
| **`--site`** | `pages/index.kiw`, `layouts/Base.kiw`, `components/Hero.kiw` | Removed | Static marketing sites & portfolios |
| **`--book`** | `content/docs/01-introduction.md`, `content/docs/02-getting-started.md` | Removed | Technical documentation manuals |
| **`--cli`** | `main.go`, `internal/commands/`, `internal/config/` | Replaced with `tui.App` command tree | Terminal utilities & CLI tools |
| **`--worker`**| `main.go`, `internal/jobs/`, `worker:` block in `krewire.yaml` | Replaced with queue supervisor | Background workers & cron daemons |
| **`--service`**| `main.go`, `internal/handler/`, `service:` block in `krewire.yaml` | Replaced with HTTP microservice | Headless backend REST/RPC APIs |
| **`--gateway`**| `main.go`, `internal/config/`, `gateway:` block in `krewire.yaml` | Replaced with reverse proxy engine | API gateways & ingress routing |
| **`--infra`** | `infra/blueprint.go`, `infra:` block in `krewire.yaml` | Removed | Declarative cloud resource topologies |

---

## 4. Directory Structures by Workload Kind

### Fullstack Monolith (`--app`)
```text
my-app/
├── krewire.yaml
├── go.mod
├── main.go
├── internal/
│   ├── app/              # Dependency injection & providers
│   ├── config/           # Typed configuration parsing
│   └── http/             # HTTP controllers & middleware
├── web/
│   ├── components/       # Reusable .kiw components
│   ├── layouts/          # Page layouts (Base, Dashboard)
│   ├── pages/            # SSR web pages
│   └── theme/            # Theme styling tokens
└── assets/               # Static images, styles, scripts
```

### Static Website (`--site`)
```text
my-site/
├── krewire.yaml
├── layouts/
│   └── Base.kiw
├── components/
│   └── Hero.kiw
├── pages/
│   └── index.kiw
└── public/
    └── favicon.svg
```

### Documentation Book (`--book`)
```text
my-book/
├── krewire.yaml
└── content/
    └── docs/
        ├── 01-introduction.md
        └── 02-getting-started.md
```

### Command-Line Utility (`--cli`)
```text
my-cli/
├── krewire.yaml
├── go.mod
├── main.go
└── internal/
    ├── commands/         # Subcommands (tui.NewCommand)
    └── config/           # CLI configuration loader
```

---

## 5. Custom Remote Templates

Developers can initialize projects from any remote Git repository:

```bash
krew init --template https://github.com/example/starter-saas.git
```

- Target directory must be empty.
- Clones repository with `--depth 1` and cleans internal `.git` tracking history.
- The remote repository must provide its own valid `krewire.yaml`.
